name: Sales
overview: Scripture emphasizes integrity and fairness in all sales transactions, forbidding deceitful practices such as using false weights or measures, which are described as an abomination to the Lord (Leviticus 19:35; Deuteronomy 25:13; Proverbs 11:1, 20:10). Believers are instructed not to oppress one another when buying or selling, highlighting the importance of just and honest dealings (Leviticus 25:14). Furthermore, the Bible recognizes the blessing that comes upon those who conduct sales righteously, contrasting it with the curse on those who withhold resources unjustly (Proverbs 11:26).
